info.title: ColorLoop read-only API
info.description: Selected existing reads and bounded read-only export endpoints. All non-public donor-level reads require the existing HttpOnly cookie, verified TOTP/recovery MFA and RBAC. GET does not require CSRF; mutations are not part of this specification and still require exact Origin and session CSRF. This specification does not create API credentials. Login/MFA throttling remains enforced; no distributed per-read rate limiter is claimed. Apply hosting edge limits as appropriate.

servers.description: Same-origin API base; configure the application HTTPS origin separately.

get.description: PII includes authorized category donor names/IDs. Dates must be within one calendar year. Null percentages mean no prior-period denominator; missing history is not invented. Board scope overrides caller board filter.

Authorized donor-level verified USD gifts and evidence-backed outcomes. fullHistory=true derives the full donor date range; otherwise from/to are required. This is a report object, not a paginated collection.

Uses the existing server-only REPORTING_API_KEY bearer credential, not a donor API-key system. Returns no donor IDs/names/emails or raw gifts. Configured program labels and board identifiers are included; keep PII out of program labels. Do not expose this credential to browser clients. No writes, session creation or MFA bypass for donor-level endpoints.
Public schema metadata only; contains no configuration values, credentials or donor records.

donation_date.description: Source calendar date; some PostgreSQL transports serialize an ISO timestamp.
